thread:
nico-e: Heads-up: target cutover for API version migration tonight 22:30 PT. We'll enable the v2 default and the backward-compat shim for explicit v1 traffic. Ops-eyes + SRE watching. Flag any reasons to delay.

tara-pm: Planning note: release notes drafted under docs/releases/v2-migration.md. I added a short FAQ about header behaviour and edge cases.

shay: Quick clarifying Q — what's the exact routing rule when both `X-API-Version` and `Accept-Version` are absent? Some clients strip custom headers.

nico-e: Rule is: if neither header present -> route to v2. If `X-API-Version: v1` or `Accept-Version: v1` -> route to v1. We flip `default_to_v2=true` in deploy.

deploy-bot: scheduled deploy deploy-1712504321 at 2026-03-21T22:30:00Z, regions=[us-west1,us-east1,eu-west1], rollout_strategy=regional-canary(10%,50%,100%). Auto-pause thresholds attached.

infra: Pre-deploy infra checks: gateway certificate rotation pending in eu-west1, will finish by 21:45 PT. We recommend starting rollout after rotation completes. Also increased lb connection drain timeout to 45s.

nico-e: Good catch. Let's move window to 23:15 PT to give cert rotation time. New deploy-bot schedule?

deploy-bot: rescheduled deploy deploy-1712504321 -> 2026-03-21T23:15:00Z. Pause triggers unchanged.

sre-oncall: Proposed immediate rollback triggers (5m sliding window):
- 5xx rate > 0.8% global
- p95 latency > 2.5x baseline for two consecutive 1m intervals
- any tenant-level 5xx spike > 0.7% of traffic attributable to that tenant
If triggered: pin header negotiation to v1 for affected region, run `playbooks/rollback_v2.sh`, and escalate to oncall.

tara-pm: Also: please tag logs with `consumer_declared_version` so we can measure how many clients explicitly ask for v1 vs default to v2. We'll need that for the postmortem if anything goes sideways.

shay: Can we also add a short client-side snippet for mobile SDKs (they sometimes rely on defaulting)? I want to include it in the FAQ.

nico-e: Yep. Anna will paste a sample snippet in the doc.

infra: Note about header normalization: API gateway currently lowercases header names; the routing rule looks for `Accept-Version` case-sensitively. We pushed a normalization rule to staging to map `accept-version` -> `Accept-Version`. Patch PR: https://git.internal/r/infra/4567 Please review.

deploy-bot: auto-pause enabled: if region reports 5xx > 0.5% for 4m OR p95 > 2x baseline for 6m. When paused, create rollback ticket and ping #eng-releases.

sre-oncall: I'll be in the room during the first regional flip. If it pauses, follow rollback playbook and set `deploy-bot pin-version --target=v1 --reason=rollback` then `kubectl apply -f routing/pin-v1.yaml`.

tara-pm: Ops-eyes schedule: first-region flip @23:15, second @23:30, third @23:45. We'll post status at +10m and +30m after final region.

nico-e: One more operational change: we'll emit a short metric `api.version.defaulted_to_v2` with a 1-minute counter so we can see clients that didn't set headers. Keep that on short retention for 72h.

shay: Thanks. I'm adding a warning in the release notes: "If you receive 400s after cutover, check gateway header normalization and ensure Accept-Version is preserved."

infra: Certificate rotation finished early; starting preflight canaries now.

deploy-bot: canary pass in us-west1 (10% slice) at 2026-03-21T23:16:30Z. Proceeding to 50% slice in us-west1.

sre-oncall: Observability: p95 stable, 5xx at 0.06%. Keep watching tenant-level spikes.

deploy-bot: us-west1 50% slice complete. Proceeding to us-east1 10% canary.

nico-e: Reminder: once rollout completes, we'll mark the release notes as "stable" and follow up with a migration telemetry digest.

shay: One small note for mobile SDK owners: ensure you set `X-API-Version` explicitly if you want v1 behavior, or update SDK in next patch.

deploy-bot: rollout complete in all regions at 2026-03-21T23:44:40Z. No auto-pauses triggered.

sre-oncall: Final checks: global 5xx=0.07%, p95 within normal baseline. No tenant hotspots. Closing ops-eyes in 30m if remains green.

tara-pm: Thanks all. I'll cut the final release note and send a summary to #general and product stakeholders at +30m.

nico-e: Excellent work. Follow-up: tracker ticket for follow-on work to migrate long-tail clients who omit headers. I'll open it. :tada:
